This compares to the present fuel consumption of NPA's, which is 8.7 percent of all highway vehicle fuel. Therefore, the agency concluded that section 502(b) reflected a policy which reduces the consumption of petroleum and that no congressional action to relieve the Secretary of Transportation of the requirement to promulgate automotive fuel economy standards for NPA's should be sought.
Taking no action may result in the manufacturers following their voluntary plans for fuel economy improvement. The environmental impact if these plans are followed is likely to be an annual savings in gasoline for the total fleet of 102.1 million gallons and the lifetime savings for the total fleet of 1,021 million gallons, over baseline levels assuming no fuel economy penalty of the MY 1979 emission standard.
